Suppose ${X}_{1},{X}_{2},{X}_{3},{X}_{4}$ is an I.I.D random sample with ${X}_{i}∼Po(\theta )$ with unknown rate parameter $\theta .$ You're given the particular sample

$$
{x}_{1}=4,\,{x}_{2}=2,\,{x}_{3}=1,\,{x}_{4}=2.
$$

The log-likelihood function of the sample is given by

$$
l(\theta )=a\theta +b\operatorname{ln}⁡\theta -\operatorname{ln}⁡c.
$$

Find the value of $a+b+c.$

*Hint: The probability mass function for a Poisson distribution is given by* 

$$
f(x)=\frac{{\theta }^{x}{e}^{-\theta }}{x!},\,x=0,1,2,…
$$
